verdict.rationale: SigNoz has its own export features in open formats: the full dashboard spec can be downloaded as JSON, and individual panels can be downloaded as CSV, PNG or SVG. It is also open-source and self-hostable, so users 'keep full control of your data plane', and it ingests standard OpenTelemetry. However, the evidence documents no bulk export of all stored traces, logs and metrics, and no exit or migrate-away tooling (the migration guides only cover moving into SigNoz). Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all telemetry (traces/logs/metrics) in open formats, export of alerts, roles and other configuration, an outbound migration or exit path, and independent hands-on corroboration.
